items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I played with Joe, yeah, Joe played with me a couple of times with Sam Bang.

ctx.x: What about Joe Robichaux in the old days before you got, you know, you make you come back with Bunk?

Who the old man? Young Joe. Young Joe. Oh. No, I never played with, yeah, I played with Joe, yeah, Joe played with me a couple of times with Sam Bang. We went on the road, Birmingham, different places, Mobile. Yeah, Joe played a couple of jobs with us.
So he worked with Sam Joe then?

items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: they liked Jim, they liked everybody that was in the band.

ctx.x: I mean, he's a big star, but sometimes his band isn't the greatest.

Yeah, well that's what they thought, but the most thing it was, I think it was because they said it was traditional. Yeah, they liked that. And they liked that, you see. And they really liked the band and all the fellas, they liked Jim, they liked everybody that was in the band. And everywhere we went at, we had a real welcome. And those fellas over there could tell me about musicians I didn't know anything about because they know that everybody played in Kit Thomas' band. And they called some fellas I didn't…
